digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output retry mechanism (pydantic-ai integration)
propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured with a single bounded pydantic-ai Agent operation preserving request budget and full history across output-retry attempts

Wire-projection HistoryProcessor must include failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when response tokens plus effective_max_tokens fit the model window; else omit entire response while all_messages() retains full history

Concision-aware guard on prompted branch (TextOutput) raises ModelRetry with truncation instruction when finish_reason signals length/max_tokens; delegates to shared check_response for parse/validation errors and terminal cases
Authoritative-input-only overflow (input_tokens + effective_max_tokens exceeding window) raises ContextWindowExceededError without content shortening

Single shared request budget (base + output-retry allowance) and counter ensures output retry exhausts before request limit; NativeOutput branch runs under same operation with pai_output.guard_capability() (not concision guard) and keeps truncation terminal

build_usage_limits returns bare base req_limit for telemetry/banking; output-retry allowance is addend only inside constructed UsageLimits, preserving inverse relationships for completion_banking and plan_recovery_pool
